verdict.rationale: Mixpanel ships a Flows capability: its MCP docs list "flows" alongside funnels and retention as queryable reports, and a hands-on user praised the Flow feature for getting "to the heart of… user flows" quickly. The same community thread notes the hover-based UI is effortful to dig into, which tempers usability. Missing for 10: first-party Flows documentation showing paths anchored before or after a chosen event, recent independent corroboration (the community feedback is old), and evidence of the path-filtering and breakdown depth a PM would use.
